listing.name: One Must Fall 2097 / OpenOMF (omf2097)
listing.summary: Explore One Must Fall 2097 / OpenOMF (omf2097) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Start the game
steps.instruction: The official archive includes the freeware One Must Fall 2097 resources and the native OpenOMF player. Choose Play after installation; no commercial source files or generation step are needed. The package also includes an ARM64 player; this route uses openomf.exe for x86-64.

steps.title: Keep your progress
steps.instruction: OpenOMF resolves writable settings, saves, scores, screenshots, recordings and user mods through its OpenOMF user-preference directory, normally AppData/OpenOMF on Windows. That external data remains outside Portcove backups. Package resources and bundled mods remain version-owned; no in-folder player-data paths are declared. Use an external registration for custom OPENOMF_* storage overrides.

presentation.manual_preparation: The official archive includes the freeware One Must Fall 2097 resources and the native OpenOMF player. Choose Play after installation; no commercial source files or generation step are needed. The package also includes an ARM64 player; this route uses openomf.exe for x86-64. OpenOMF resolves writable settings, saves, scores, screenshots, recordings and user mods through its OpenOMF user-preference directory, normally AppData/OpenOMF on Windows. That external data remains outside Portcove backups. Package resources and bundled mods remain version-owned; no in-folder player-data paths are declared. Use an external registration for custom OPENOMF_* storage overrides. Existing external installations keep their files and runtime update owner. Gameplay, platform minimums and packaged Desktop acceptance remain separate observations.
